evidence: The entire mobile Voting feature references i18n keys that do not exist in ANY locale file. The `voting` block in frontend/apps/mobile/src/locales/en.json (and sk/cs/de/hu/pl.json — all identical) contains only 8 keys: title, activePolls, completedPolls, vote, voted, results, deadline, noPolls. But VoteDetailScreen.tsx + VotingScreen.tsx call t() on at least 13 keys that are absent: voting.castError (VoteDetailScreen.tsx:245), voting.loadError (VotingScreen.tsx:253, VoteDetailScreen.tsx:301), voting.tapToVote (VotingScreen.tsx:315), voting.tapToView (VotingScreen.tsx:316), voting.openDetail (VotingScreen.tsx:268), voting.confirmVoteTitle/confirmVoteMessage (VoteDetailScreen.tsx:212/219), voting.answerRequired (:213), voting.voteSubmitted (:240), voting.confirmationNumber (:241), voting.missingId (:187), voting.noQuestions (:329), voting.youHaveVoted (:381), voting.notActive (:389), voting.votingAs (:413), voting.submit (:223/:354). Verified missing by parsing en.json: every one of these returns None.

The `t('voting.X') ?? 'English fallback'` guard the authors wrote at every one of these call sites is DEAD CODE and does not protect against the missing key. react-i18next's t() returns a `string` — for a missing lookup it returns the key itself ('voting.castError') when returnNull is false, which is the i18next default and is NOT overridden in frontend/apps/mobile/src/i18n/config.ts (no returnNull/returnEmptyString/parseMissingKeyHandler set). A non-empty string is truthy and non-nullish, so the `?? "Couldn't submit ballot"` branch never executes. Net user-visible effect: on the Voting flow a user sees raw dotted identifiers — e.g. the cast-vote confirmation dialog shows title 'voting.confirmVoteTitle' and body 'voting.confirmVoteMessage', the submit button reads 'voting.submit', and a failed/loaded-error alert title reads 'voting.castError' / 'voting.loadError' — instead of either a translation or the intended English fallback. Confirmed in all 6 locales (sk/cs/de/hu/pl mirror en and are equally missing the keys), so there is no locale where these render correctly.

Severity MEDIUM (+2): user-facing text is broken across an entire feature (confirm dialog, error alerts, action buttons, empty/eligibility banners), including the two error-path strings castError/loadError that appear precisely when something already went wrong — degraded but not a crash and no data loss, hence +2 not +3. The i18n-gap-only rubric would be +1, but this is a whole-feature gap compounded by a systematically broken fallback mechanism, so it is scored as a user-facing-breakage finding. Confidence HIGH: statically confirmed by (a) absence of every referenced key from en.json/sk/cs/de and (b) i18next's documented default of returning the key string (truthy) for a missing lookup with returnNull unset, which makes the `??` fallbacks provably unreachable. Fix: add the missing voting.* keys to all locales (the inline `?? '...'` English literals are the ready-made en source), optionally drop the now-redundant `??` fallbacks; also audit for the same t()??literal dead-fallback pattern elsewhere (e.g. documents.loadError at DocumentsScreen.tsx:344 and common.* which do exist, so only voting.* currently surfaces raw).
